engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or connections faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  wiring and connections for G284
If connections are ok, change passenger side crash sensor (G284) with drivers side sensor (G283). If the fault change also, you found a faulty sensor. Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  it

If changing G283 with G284 does not change the fault, then Kontrol edin: wiring between G284 and Airbag Control Unit.
If someone repaired or replaced the 2 wire connector at the crash sensor and reversed (swapped) the wiring the DTC may show: Open or Artı (12V) Kutba Kısa Devre - MIL ON.  The wiring diagram for the vehicle in question will add clarity.

Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the NAR (North American Region) New Beetle and New Beetle Convertible models see if the R6 / 69H1 Safety Recall was completed. The TSB involves replacing both crash sensors (G284 & G283) when the old / early production sensors are instated.
The common fault codes are 01739 and / or 01738
